title: Amazon Products Scraping
fullDescription: In this project, the client tasked me with scraping 60 categories, each containing various subcategories, from Amazon. Each category and its subcategories had 100 products, all of which were Amazon's best sellers. I had to scrape every single product, but it wasn't as straightforward as it sounds. There were specific criteria that each product needed to meet. In addition to that, I had to download ALL the product pictures. This project turned out to be quite exciting as I successfully scraped over 100,000 products and filtered out many based on the specified criteria.

title: Excel Automation
shortDescription: Automated financial reporting system for a Fortune 500 company
fullDescription: Automated financial reporting system for a Fortune 500 company. Implemented VBA macros to streamline monthly reporting processes, reducing manual work by 80%. Created dynamic dashboards for real-time financial insights.

title: Python PDF Page Deletion
shortDescription: Python script to delete PDF pages based on bookmark content
fullDescription: In this project, I developed an automation script using Python. The script deletes pages from PDF files if the bookmark related to that page contains specific words from a predefined list. The project was interesting as it required me to make the script efficient enough to handle more than 30,000 pages quickly. I successfully created a script that can handle such PDFs in under a minute.

title: Holiday Bonus Calculator
shortDescription: System to calculate employee bonus holidays monthly
fullDescription: For this project, I developed a comprehensive bonus calculator designed to track and calculate employee bonus holidays on a monthly basis. The system was built to handle a complex set of conditions, ensuring employees' eligibility was accurately determined. Key features included: Monthly tracking of sick leave data, Eligibility checks based on consecutive weeks without sick leave, Automated calculation of bonus holidays for employees meeting the criteria. This solution streamlined the process, making bonus holiday management more efficient for the organization.

title: Transportation Management System
shortDescription: Complete transportation management system with automated notifications
fullDescription: Built a complete transportation management system using Google Sheets. Included a dashboard and tab for creating bus schedules, automatic SMS/email notifications to drivers, weekly reports generation, live driver tracking, and other essential features for efficient transportation management.

title: Movie Data Scraping
shortDescription: Scraped detailed data for over 5,000 movies
fullDescription: Scraped data for over 5,000 movies including titles, release dates, ratings and other details. Ensured accurate and well-organized data ready for analysis or reporting. Demonstrated large-scale web scraping capabilities.

title: Point of Sale in Microsoft Excel
shortDescription: Complete POS system with inventory management and reporting
fullDescription: In this project, I developed a point of sale (POS) system. It included all the essential features like adding items, creating and printing bills, and managing sales transactions. The system made it easy to keep track of inventory, generate reports, and handle customer payments. It was a complete solution for any business looking to streamline their sales process!

title: Chrome Extension to Scrape Facebook Ads
shortDescription: Built a Chrome Extension to scrape Facebook Ads based on client-defined criteria
fullDescription: Developed a custom Chrome Extension that scrapes Facebook Ads data according to specific filters defined by the client. The tool collects relevant ad information, filters based on duration and other metrics, and exports the data into a clean, structured CSV file. It was built for performance, ease of use, and to save manual effort during analysis.
